create_DBConfig_dataclass: create a DBConfig dataclass with driver, host, and port fields for database configuration
create_MySQLConfig_dataclass: create a MySQLConfig dataclass extending DBConfig with mysql driver, port 3306, user, and password
create_PostGreSQLConfig_dataclass: create a PostGreSQLConfig dataclass extending DBConfig with postgresql driver, port 5432, user, password, and timeout
run_register_configs: run register_configs to store MySQLConfig and PostGreSQLConfig in the Hydra ConfigStore under database_lib/db group
review_DBConfig_inheritance: review the DBConfig base class and how MySQLConfig and PostGreSQLConfig override driver and port defaults
